derivative_label: sanitized fixtures, not byte-identical original inputs
checks: query names including key/token/auth/credential/signature/sig, cloud signed-URL parameters and opaque uid
known original access-like values in every deliverable, including decompressed archives
private-key, bearer-token and common service-token patterns

content_digest_exception.reason: Historical compiler computes SHA-256 over catalogue, profiles, graph and compiler digests; this is a content/cache digest, not an authentication signature. Values required to be 64 hex characters.

source_attribution: Preserve all names, credits, licence text/URLs and query parameter names; remove only bounded potential-access values. Opaque uid is conservatively removed without claiming it is a credential.
unknown_sensitive_fields_policy: Any unresolved potential credential field outside the documented transformed query values blocks that deliverable.
known_limits: Bounded structural/known-value scan, not proof against every possible encoded or unknown secret. No unresolved flagged metadata remains. Current live published exposure is not established.
